title: "wrapped fixture: unknown keys under wrapped"
filters:
  - wrapped
wrapped:
  width: 30%
  wrap-gap: 2em
  Width: 25%
  zeta: 1
  alpha: 2
  margin: 3
  Gap: 4
format:
  html: default
  epub: default
---

The `wrapped:` map takes `width`, `gap`, and `breakpoint`. Each other key
prints a warning and changes nothing, so the figure takes the known key's
width of 30% and the default gap and breakpoint.

![A figure under unknown wrapped keys.](plot.png){#fig-unknown .wrap-right}
